title: When Agent Evaluation Becomes Unreliable: An Empirical Study of Oracle Failures and Configuration-Dependent Measurement in an LLM Agent Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2610.16067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent evaluation harnesses are software systems that run test suites, generate inputs, and decide outcomes with test oracles. This paper audits such software for reliability defects that score tables cannot reveal.   We introduce an oracle-integrity auditing approach with five state-integrity invariants and three known-answer controls. We evaluate it by injecting seven oracle defect classes across two task domains and a synthetic domain. All injected defect classes are detected, and the repaired oracle has no false positives. Applied to an agent benchmark, the audit reveals a reward-function defect that changes the environment state before post-run scoring. Across 4,320 episodes, replay-based correction changes database-pass labels from 4,194 to 2,883 and reduces measured success from 94.3% to 65.5%. translated_title: 当智能体评估变得不可靠时：LLM智能体基准测试中的预言机故障与配置依赖性测量的实证研究
translated_abstract: 智能体评估工具是运行测试套件、生成输入并通过测试预言机判定结果的软件系统。本文对这类软件进行审计，以发现分数表无法揭示的可靠性缺陷。我们提出了一种预言机完整性审计方法，包含五个状态完整性不变量和三个已知答案控制。我们通过在两个任务域和一个合成域中注入七类预言机缺陷来评估该方法。所有注入的缺陷类别均被检测到，且修复后的预言机没有误报。应用于一个智能体基准测试时，该审计揭示了一个奖励函数缺陷，该缺陷会在运行后评分之前改变环境状态。在4,320个回合中，基于重放的校正将数据库通过标签从4,194个变为2,883个，并将测得的成功率从94.3%降至65.5%。我们还研究了配置依赖的测量效应。在3,240个回合上的组件消融实验表明，智能体的策略文档（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种面向LLM智能体评估工具的预言机完整性审计方法，发现了一个会在评分前改变环境状态的奖励函数缺陷，使基准测得的成功率从94.3%降至65.5%，并揭示了配置依赖的测量效应对评估结果的显著影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an oracle-integrity auditing approach for LLM agent evaluation harnesses, uncovering a reward-function defect that alters environment state before scoring—reducing measured success from 94.3% to 65.5%—and revealing configuration-dependent measurement effects in agent benchmarks.
